o.text: From Proto-Turkic *turńa. Cognate with Turkish turna, Chuvash тӑрна (tărna), etc.
From earlier *ügütmək, ultimately from Proto-Common Turkic *ügi- (“to grind”). Cognate to Salar ükgüsi, Turkish öğütmek, Turkmen üwetmek, etc.
